title: Valid Parentheses
description:
A string s contains only the bracket characters ()[]{}. Return true if every opening bracket has a later matching closing bracket and the pairs are properly nested; otherwise return false. An empty string is valid because it contains no unmatched brackets.

Matching counts alone are insufficient: (] is invalid despite having an opener and a closer, and ([)] is invalid because the close order crosses the opening order. Every closing bracket must match the most recent opening bracket that has not already been closed.

This makes the task a natural use of last-in, first-out memory. As characters arrive, retain unmatched openers; on a close, check the top and reject immediately if it is absent or of the wrong kind. A remaining opener at the end also makes the complete string invalid.

Example 1:

Input: s = "()[]{}"
Output: true

Example 2:

Input: s = "([)]"
Output: false

Example 3:

Input: s = "{[]}"
Output: true

Constraints:

  • 0 <= s.length <= 10,000.
  • s contains only ( ) [ ] { } characters.
  • The result is a boolean, not a collection of matching pairs.
